author: Michael Larabel
description: Intel's intriguing Crescent Island Xe3P-based AI accelerator hardware now known as the Intel GPU D Series continues seeing a lot of Linux kernel driver activity. The upcoming Linux 7.5 kernel is continuing to build out the support for this upcoming hardware...
title: Intel Continues Enabling The GPU D-Series "Crescent Island" Driver Support For Linux 7.5

author: Michael Larabel
description: Yesterday in the AMD EPYC 9006 "Venice" SP7 launch testing were reviews of the AMD EPYC 9996 256-core processor as well as the EPYC 9686F 96-core high frequency part. There were hundreds of benchmarks looking at the gen-on-gen performance from EPYC Turin to EPYC Venice as well as against the Intel Xeon 6 Granite Rapids competition. For those wondering about how AMD EPYC Venice is competing with NVIDIA's Vera CPU, this article provides a look at those results for a range of HPC workloads.
title: AMD EPYC 9006 Venice vs. NVIDIA Vera Benchmarks For HPC Performance

author: Michael Larabel
description: After AMD posted GFX13 patches for the AMDGPU Linux driver earlier in the week, today they opened the Mesa merge request for introducing the very primitive GFX13 support for the RADV Vulkan and RadeonSI Gallium3D/OpenGL drivers...
title: Initial AMD RDNA5/GFX13 Code Sent Out For Mesa RADV & RadeonSI Drivers

author: Michael Larabel
description: The FreeBSD Project published its Q3'2026 status report on Tuesday that outlines a number of development initiatives to ongoing work around an AI policy for this BSD operating system...
title: FreeBSD Working To Establish An AI Policy After Polling Developers

author: Michael Larabel
description: Over 24 years old, the ATI (AMD) Radeon R300 graphics processors are still seeing improvements in the open-source Linux driver space. Merged to Mesa 27.0-devel this week were a number of shader compiler optimizations for the R300g driver that benefits not only the original R300 series graphics cards but also the R400 and R500 (Radeon X1000 series) too...
title: ATI/AMD R300 To R500 GPUs See New 2026 OpenGL Linux Driver Optimizations

author: Michael Larabel
description: With yesterday's launch availability of the AMD EPYC 9006 "Venice" SP7 processors headlined by the incredibly fast EPYC 9996 and EPYC 9686F processors, AMD also launched AOCC 6.0 as the newest version of their in-house LLVM/Clang-based compiler stack...
title: AMD AOCC 6.0 Brings Zen 6 Optimizations, New "aof" Fortran Compiler, aoc / aoc++ Branding
